cohort: Singleton pregnant women aged 16-45 years old, without pre-existing medical diseases, who delivered at Bhumibol Adulyadej Hospital.
finding: Pre-pregnancy obesity, both independently and in women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), is associated with increased risks of maternal complications (PIH, GHT, preeclampsia) and adverse neonatal outcomes (higher birth weight, LGA, NICU admission, respiratory distress, birth asphyxia).
